answer_1.quote: We present AIR-Bench, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of LALMs to comprehend various audio signals and to interact following instructions ... LALMs are required to generate hypothesis sequences directly ... generating textual responses following human instructions.
answer_1.outputs: textual responses / dialogue answers generated from audio inputs

answer_2.quote: We adopt reference-based GPT-4 evaluators to judge the generation quality of LALMs in the audio domain ... The GPT-4 evaluator is GPT-4 Turbo, the gpt-4-0125-preview version.

answer_3.quote: We leverage a unified evaluation method ... we employ GPT-4 as the evaluator, which compares the hypothesis against a reference answer ... we perform a second scoring round by swapping their positions and then compute the average of the two scores.

answer_4.quote: To evaluate the consistency between the evaluations of GPT-4 and human judgments, we design experiments ... Qwen-Audio-Chat as a representative model and randomly selected 400 questions ... evaluated by three native English speakers ... For the chat benchmark, we conduct pairwise comparisons among ... evaluated by three native English speakers.
answer_4.guideline: Humans were asked to determine which option aligns closest with the hypothesis for the foundation benchmark, and to compare model responses based on usefulness, relevance, accuracy, and comprehensiveness for the chat benchmark.
